title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode3 Heart-Pounding Presentation

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: HeartUp Creation Headquarters

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
That concludes our presentation.
Thank you for your time!

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
That was an excellent proposal. You did a wonderful job of highlighting this product's features.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Making a mosaic out of message cards is such a cool idea...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd love to see what the finished piece looks like! I want to give it a try too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it's a good idea to let anyone participate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm so impressed!
Everyone's come up with such fun ideas.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
Next, we have...
Ms. Tenma's group. Please come to the front.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's us...!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But we also gave our idea a lot of thought, too. And the other two helped turn it into a really great proposal...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We just gotta believe in what we're about to present...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-We've come up with an event involving guests writing their own message cards using Saishi Kobo's products!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We believe actually using their products is the best way for customers to understand just how much thought and effort they put into them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we also felt that just writing message cards like normal wouldn't be enough to convince people to attend this event.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is how we arrived upon our “Say Thank You On White Day” event.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Ah, White Day, you say...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! This event is going to take place at the beginning of March, which is the perfect time to prepare for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our guess is that a lot of people will be at the mall shopping for gifts to thank others for what they gave them on Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why we'd like to hold a workshop where our guests will get to make message cards to attach to their presents...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we think that even people who don't use stationery often will be really interested in participating!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially since White Day is all about thanking those you care about the most. And we believe these cards will help them do just that!

rows.Speaker: Student Leader
rows.Line: In other words, you'll be helping them send their thoughts...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It can be hard to thank those who are closest to you or who you care about the most...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But people may find it easier to share those feelings that are hard to put into words, in the form of a thoughtful card.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, Saishi Kobo worked really hard on coming up with these great product designs that go with their mission of “helping you send your thoughts”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why we believe everybody will find just the cards they're looking for to make their intended recipient happy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We believe that we'll be able to convince a lot of people to participate as long as we stay on that message.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We want everyone to learn all about how great Saishi Kobo's products are...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And help everyone say, “Thank you,” to those they care about the most!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That concludes this presentation.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Not only did you come up with a solid concept, you really thought out of the box there by coupling it with White Day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
As far as flaws go...
There are quite a few stationery companies out there that make message cards using special designs and materials.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: So, one could argue that you didn't quite do a good job of explaining why Saishi Kobo's cards, specifically, are the best choice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's true, we didn't sufficiently address that angle.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Still, you deserve a pat on the back for coming up with this in such a short amount of time. Thank you all for your hard work.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
That concludes this shadowing.
Thank you all for coming to visit us today.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I feel like my brain's gonna melt after all that thinking...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We used our heads in a way that we don't normally while studying.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But coming up with ideas and giving a presentation together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I learned so much from the other groups' presentations too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. They even gave us advice on what we could do better, so I wanna make the most of what they said if we ever do something like this again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
I need to write the rough draft of my report.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
I should summarize everything that we learned today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, since we finished a little early, why don't we all—

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
Ms. Tenma, Ms. Hinomori, Ms. Otori.
Do you all have some time to talk before you head out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, how can we help you?

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
It's about your event proposal...
We've actually been planning something very similar.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: The details differ slightly, but the overall idea of writing message cards for White Day is basically the same.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Yes. So, if you all have time, you'd be more than welcome to come visit our event.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that'd be great!
I actually really want to make message cards using Saishi Kobo's stationery now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your event...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Excuse me! If possible...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I helped out with this event?!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I really learned a lot today about how companies come up with ideas and run planning meetings!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'd like to learn even more about how these sorts of events are actually run!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
I see. In that case, welcome aboard.
We'll be more than happy to have someone with your energy there to help us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Would you two like to join her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Us? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Yes. We had budgeted to hire part-timers as the staff, so you'll even get paid for your work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We get to help out with their event.
That means...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We want everyone to learn all about how great Saishi Kobo's products are...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And help everyone say, “Thank you,” to those they care about the most!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We get to do what we said during our presentation...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I'd like to help out as well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm also curious to see what this event is actually like. I'd like to join them.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Understood. I'll let those in charge know right away. We look forward to working with you on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! Thank you for having us!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
This is awesome! We get to help run their event☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means we gotta do our best to make sure all the guests go home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
